digest.component_or_area: Configuration ownership and legacy facade removal
propositions: AST-based ownership gate must reject direct ambient config/credential reads, aliased environment access patterns, backend property reloads, and undeclared adapter defaults below approved composition seams.

Ownership registry and generated documentation (config/security lifecycle) must be kept in sync with schema and provider credential registries, with drift detection covering restart, refresh, observability, and behavior deltas.

Legacy facades, switches, and migration exceptions must not be removed until focused behavioral suites pass, AST gate confirms zero ambient reads in the real tree, and bounded live canaries with redacted evidence complete successfully.
The structural ownership gate is a deterministic change detector and must not substitute for behavioral regression oracles from prior composition phases (S1-S6).
